name: Kanban Drag
description: A cursor picks up a card, which lifts and leans into the drag; the source column closes its gap, the destination opens one with a dashed placeholder, the card springs into place and its status flips to Done.
move: A cursor picks up a card, which lifts and leans into the drag; the source column closes its gap, the destination opens one with a dashed placeholder, the card springs into place and its status flips to Done.
how: All cards are absolutely positioned. The dragged card follows the cursor path; its tilt is the cursor’s horizontal velocity (clamped ±7°) plus a lift lean, and lift drives scale and shadow. Drop settles with a damped spring. Column gaps are relative y tweens; counts roll.
adapt: Edit COLS (title, tag, id). The dragged card is column 1, index 0; change drag/slot to move another. Placeholder product names and copy are generic. Colours come from the palette tokens at the top of the page (--bg, --surface, --ink, --muted, --accent, --accent-2); change those to re-brand it.
port: Timeline-driven: register the page's CustomEase curves, scope selectors to the shot and rebuild the timeline; state painted in onUpdate must stay a function of tl.time().
caveats: Original implementation; no third-party UI kit, product or brand assets.
Starts and ends on its opening frame so it loops; trim the exit when cutting to the next shot.
